profile.headline: Full Stack Developer at Bringer Corporation
profile.summary: I learned how to program when I was 13 years old, I discovered that I liked it and decided to dedicate myself to it professionally, everything that I practically learned it by myself, I took a course at the beginning and from there everything came

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Integral Infrastructure Design
I was in charge of design all infrastructure at bringerparcel.com, Web Services, Database Services, Cache Services (Redis), micro-services, cloud and On-premises.
- Backend development
In charge of creating new backend from scratch, new features and maintenance of the code using NodeJS
- Development of the frontend from scratch, new features and UX using React.js with tools like redux, recoil, Socket.io (integrating my own parser for performance improvement) and many others.
positions.insights: Skills: Webpack · Server Management · Full-Stack Development · MySQL · SOAP · Single Page Applications · React.js · Software Development · uWebsockets.js · Express.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · WebSocket · Redis · Linux · Node.js
